definitions.explanation: Noticeably different from what is normal or expected in a way that is unsettling or disturbing. Stronger than simply unusual — implies something feels wrong or off-putting.

examples.japanese: {異様|いよう}な⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧だった。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{異様|いよう}な⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: Everyone was startled by his bizarre behavior.

examples.japanese: ⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{異様|いよう}な⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえて→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧きて、⟦{思|おも}わ→思う：00492_omou⟧ず⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}めた→止める：00678_tomeru⟧。
examples.english: I heard a strange sound coming from the park late at night and involuntarily stopped in my tracks.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a na-adjective ({異様|いよう}な) to describe things that are strikingly strange or unsettling. Often used to describe atmospheres, appearances, sounds, or behaviors that feel abnormal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {異様|いよう}な⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧ (eerie atmosphere)
- {異様|いよう}な⟦{光景|こうけい}→光景：02799_koukei⟧ (bizarre sight)
- {異様|いよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧ (eerily quiet)
- {異様|いよう}な{臭|にお}い (strange smell)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{奇妙|きみょう}→奇妙：01630_kimyou⟧: strange, odd (intellectual curiosity, less threatening)
- ⟦{不気味|ぶきみ}→不気味：16040_bukimi⟧: creepy, eerie (specifically unsettling or frightening)
- ⟦{変|へん}→変：01124_hen⟧: strange, weird (casual, milder)
